say:3:1511243002:0.text: You didn't expect me to beat you, did you?

say:4:1511243003:0.text: You're old. So old you've lost count of the winters. Your reflexes are slow. You're a step behind every young warrior here.
say:4:1511243003:0.source_cn: 你老了，老得连自己的年岁都忘记。你的动作早就跟不上年轻人了。

say:5:1511243004:0.text: I just beat Kordan fair and square. By tradition, that makes me the new chief, right?
say:5:1511243004:0.source_cn: 喂，按照传统，打赢了戈丹，我就是下一任首领，没错吧？

say:11:1511243006:0.text: It's a pity. <style="highlight">I don't want to be chief.</style> This tribe's glory is just a memory. The great tree of the Wildborn is crumbling. I won't preside over its final decay.

say:12:1511243007:0.text: I also won't kill Kordan. I'll let him live. Time will grind him down until he's nothing but gravel and dust.
say:12:1511243007:0.source_cn: 我不会处决戈丹，让他活着，继续被时间风化磨碎吧，直到变...

say:13:1511243008:0.text: And I'm leaving the Wildborn tribe.
say:13:1511243008:0.source_cn: 而我，我要离开雅库伯尔！

say:18:1511243010:1.text: I want to leave and find the utopia that <style="stress"><player_name></style> spoke of... the <style="highlight">Dark Forest</style>...
say:18:1511243010:1.source_cn: 我要离开这里，去传说中的理想乡，去<style=str...
say:18:1511243010:1.male: I want to leave and find the utopia that <style="stress"><player_name></style> spoke of... the <style="highlight">Dark Forest</style>...
say:18:1511243010:1.female: I want to leave and find the utopia that <style="stress"><player_name></style> spoke of... the <style="highlight">Dark Forest</style>...

say:19:1511243011:0.text: Halftail's right. It doesn't matter how far it is. If we keep heading in the right direction, we can get there one day.
say:19:1511243011:0.source_cn: 椴尾说得对，不论多远，只要方向正确，总有一天能走到。

say:22:1511243012:0.text: Such arrogance...! The beasts beyond our lands will tear you limb from limb!
say:22:1511243012:0.source_cn: 不自量力……！雅库伯尔外的野兽会将你撕碎……

say:23:1511243013:0.text: You lost. Why are you still talking?

say:25:1511243014:0.text: Come on. Anyone who wants to go to the Dark Forest, follow me!
say:25:1511243014:0.source_cn: ——来吧。想一起去薄暮丛林的人，就跟我来！
